{{Top|notoc=1}}
[[File:Gold-Implant.png|thumb|150px|Gold implants on [[Bone/Legends|ribs]]]]
'''Gold''' was a yellow-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Metal/Legends|metal]]<ref name="SW48">[[Star Wars (1977) 48|''Star Wars'' (1977) 48]]</ref> that was valued by [[Sentience/Legends|sentient beings]] as both a luxury item and a metal with useful technological applications. Its value averaged ten to fifteen [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per [[gram]]. It was one of the most commonly used metals for the minting of "[[precious coins]]," coins made from valuable metals used in the more remote areas of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="P&P">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref> [[Peggat/Legends|Peggats]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Currency/Legends|currency]] used in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], were made from gold.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref>

The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]]'s enormous reserves of precious metals included gold. During [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]'s visit to the world, a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] attempted to abscond with gold concealed as implants on his fifth and sixth [[Bone/Legends|ribs]]. This gold was detected, and as this act violated Aargau's [[Three Statutes of Aargau|First Law]] prohibiting the unlawful removal of precious metals from the world, the smuggler was immediately executed.<ref name="SW48" />

[[Smoker]]s on [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]], such as the one that the [[Vault-spire]] of [[Mariunhus]] was built around, emitted superheated gases that contained extremely pure precious metals, including gold.<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

The bodies of the [[Maelibus|Maelibi]] of [[Iego/Legends|Iego]] seemed to be formed from molten gold.<ref name="GatORW" />

A [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] flew in the Battles of [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Yavin]] and [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', the strategic resource of gold was replaced with [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]].<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>
